item.title: A Website Is Not Live Until DNS Says So
item.description: A clean production deployment can still point visitors to the wrong place. Launch QA should verify DNS, custom domains, redirects, robots.txt, and sitemaps from the public URL.

item.title: Claim Hygiene Is Part of Website QA
item.description: High-trust websites need more than polished design. Every public claim should be defensible, crawlable, and aligned with the facts the site can prove.
